reference_points.note: A classical physics-only function should land well below 0.68. Several ML rescorers train on PDBbind releases overlapping the CASF-2016 core, so their figures are not all leakage-free.

trivial_size_baselines.note: If 'u_total_minus_best_trivial' is near zero or negative, the Hamiltonian adds nothing over counting atoms and any claim of physical insight is unsupported.

in_sample_multiterm_fit.caveat: Fitted and evaluated on the same complexes. This is an upper bound on what reweighting these terms could achieve, NOT a measured accuracy. For an honest fit use the LP-PDBBind split in data/raw/LP_PDBBind.csv, which provides new_split plus CL1/CL2/CL3 cluster flags specifically to prevent train/test leakage, and exclude the CASF-2016 core from training.
